title: Input symbol at an indexed configuration
statement: Let $x$ be a finite word over any symbol alphabet, let $q$ be an optional state, and let $i\le |x|$. For any work word $u$, integer work-head position $h$, and output word $o$, the symbol read by the input head in the corresponding configuration is the $i$-th symbol of $x$, or no symbol if $i=|x|$.
replaced:
Let $x$ be an input and $i \le |x|$. In every configuration of the non-tautology
verifier on $x$ whose input head has consumed $i$ bits, the symbol under the input
head is the $i$-th bit of $x$ when $i < |x|$ and the blank when $i = |x|$,
regardless of state, work tape, and output.
